sector: Polymer compounds for wires, cables and pipe coating

flags: RED: objects floor sits above blended fair value
AMBER: TV above 75% of EV - DCF is mostly a terminal guess
model.reverse_dcf: The price asks the business to deliver 22.5 times its current free cash flow, in perpetuity.

call_basis: Call rule (ROUTINE.md hard rule 6): Neutral value -45.7% and Bull value -35.9% against the Rs 150 upper band, so the Avoid limb applies on valuation. No material issue was found.
reference_note: Upper band Rs 150 (press reports; exchange notice pending). At Rs 150: market cap Rs 930.48 cr post-issue; P/E 34.5x FY26 EPS on post-issue shares (25.0x pre-issue); P/B 2.66x post-issue; EV/EBITDA 17.3x FY26 operating EBITDA. Objects floor Rs 98.27 (capex + working capital over 1.70 crore fresh shares).
headline: A profitable, cash-generative polymer compounder doubling capacity, priced at 34.5x FY26 earnings after the issue against a 14.5x peer median; our fair value is Rs 81 (Neutral) against Rs 150, because growth in the core manufactured business has been flat and the price already pays for the expansion.
red_flags: Operating EBITDA margin 5.5% -> 9.7% -> 12.0% FY24-26 (14.5% in Q1 FY27); PAT Rs 7.52 cr -> Rs 27.01 cr; cumulative CFO 118% of PAT (pp. 85-86)
Capacity to rise from 35,251 to 87,301 MTPA (+148%) by FY28 from Rs 77.56 cr of proceeds; current utilisation 73-75% (pp. 123-124)
Manufactured revenue flat to lower (Rs 254 cr -> Rs 237 cr FY24-26); growth came from resin trading, 31.9% of FY26 revenue (pp. 33, 406, 408)
Top customer 31.7% of FY26 revenue; top supplier 71.7% of procurement; purchases from promoter-group trader Vinsul Makardi 9.3% of revenue (pp. 27, 39, 89)
At Rs 150: P/E 34.5x post-issue vs peer median 14.5x (DDev Plastiks 13.0x, Kingfa 46.3x); reported P/E is a fair measure (earnings-quality adjustments -2.8%)
Fair value Rs 68 / 81 / 96 (Bear / Neutral / Bull) vs Rs 150; objects floor Rs 98; issuer KPI EBITDA leaves other income in (Rs 46.60 cr vs Rs 41.90 cr operating)

strengths: Enlisted with Maharatna, Navratna and Miniratna CPSEs for cable and pipe-coating compounds; approvals take years (pp. 139, 249)
Operating EBITDA margin up from 5.54% to 11.99% FY24-26 and 14.46% in Q1 FY27 (p. 85)
Cumulative operating cash flow 118% of PAT FY24-26; cash tax 24.7% of PBT (pp. 85-86)
weaknesses: Manufactured polymer revenue Rs 254.42 cr -> Rs 237.00 cr FY24-26 (pp. 406, 408)
Resin trading 31.86% of FY26 revenue, at lower margins (p. 33)
Top customer 31.74% and top-10 66.81% of FY26 revenue (p. 27)
opportunities: Indian polymer compounding market USD 9.9 bn (2025) to USD 16.5 bn by 2031, ~9% CAGR (issuer-paid CRISIL report, p. 179)
GCC distribution arrangement for exports to seven countries (p. 124)
Power-cable and gas-pipeline build-out (National Gas Grid, transmission) (pp. 160-246)
threats: Polyethylene price swings and dependence on a few petrochemical suppliers (p. 39)
Execution and cost-overrun risk on a 148% capacity addition (p. 29)
